data.title: Kasirku
data.description:
MY-CASHIER is a modern web-based Point of Sale (POS) and store management system designed to help retail businesses manage sales, inventory, customers, employees, and multiple store branches from a centralized platform.

The system provides a fast and intuitive cashier experience while giving owners and managers access to real-time business data, inventory monitoring, transaction history, reporting, and operational management tools.

Built with a scalable frontend-backend architecture, MY-CASHIER combines a responsive Next.js dashboard with a secure Express.js REST API and PostgreSQL database.
data.caseType: Full-Stack Web Application — Point of Sale (POS) & Retail Management System
data.caseProblem:
Small and growing retail businesses often rely on separate tools for cashier transactions, inventory tracking, employee management, customer records, and sales reporting.

This creates several operational problems:

Stock information can become inaccurate or outdated.
Owners have limited visibility into daily sales performance.
Managing multiple branches becomes difficult.
Cashiers need a faster and simpler transaction workflow.
Sales, inventory, customers, and reports are stored in separate systems.
Manual reporting increases the possibility of errors.
Business owners cannot easily monitor store activity in real time.
Invoice and transaction management requires additional manual work.

A centralized system was needed to connect all major store operations into one platform.
data.caseSolution:
MY-CASHIER was developed as an integrated Point of Sale and retail management platform that connects cashier operations, inventory, products, customers, employees, branches, and reporting through a single system.

The application uses a separated frontend and backend architecture.

The Next.js frontend provides a responsive and user-friendly workspace for owners, managers, administrators, and cashiers.

The Express.js REST API handles authentication, business logic, transactions, inventory updates, reporting, file uploads, and database communication.

PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM provides structured and reliable data management, while Cloudinary handles product images, Socket.IO supports real-time communication, and Resend provides automated email functionality.

The system also implements role-based permissions and security mechanisms to ensure each user can only access the functionality relevant to their role.
data.caseResult:
MY-CASHIER provides businesses with a centralized digital workspace for managing everyday retail operations.

The application enables:

Faster cashier transactions.
Centralized product and inventory management.
Real-time stock visibility.
Better control of multiple store branches.
Structured customer management.
Employee and role-based access management.
Automated transaction recording.
Better visibility into sales performance.
Digital invoice generation.
Email invoice delivery.
Easier business reporting and analysis.
Reduced dependency on manual spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

The project demonstrates a complete full-stack implementation of a production-oriented retail management platform, including frontend development, REST API architecture, database design, authentication, cloud integration, reporting, and deployment.

data.title: Portofolio Ahamad Fadillah
data.description: Development of an interactive HR professional portfolio website. It strategically showcases career milestones, core competencies, and project metrics. The platform elevates digital personal branding for recruiters and partners.
data.caseType: Personal Branding Website, Interactive Career Showcase, HR Portfolio Application
data.caseProblem:
Traditional PDF resumes limit spatial presentation.
Static formats fail to validate work proofs.
Complex HR program dynamics remain hidden.
Quantitative data lacks comprehensive visual display.
Recruiters struggle to evaluate practical expertise.
Stakeholders need instant career record verification.
Professional certifications remain unorganized and scattered.
data.caseSolution:
Built a modern web platform using Next.js.Implemented Tailwind CSS for responsive user interface.
Designed a clean modular structure for navigation.
Created dedicated sections for HR core specializations.
Integrated visual verification for 5+ professional certifications.
Embedded instant resume download functionality.
Connected direct communication channels via WhatsApp/Email.
data.caseResult:
Launched a centralized digital career information hub.
Documented positive impacts on 100+ employees.
Significantly elevated personal branding market value.
Accelerated profile review times for hiring managers.
Provided data-backed validation of strategic HR expertise.

data.title: BLP Beauty E-Commerce Website Redesign
data.description: A modern beauty e-commerce website redesign for BLP Beauty with a clean UI, responsive layout, product showcase, and improved shopping experience.
data.caseType: E-Commerce Platform, Beauty Website, Landing Page Redesign
data.caseProblem: The existing beauty website needed a more modern and professional interface, better product presentation, smoother navigation, and a responsive layout that works well on both desktop and mobile devices.
data.caseSolution: I redesigned and developed a modern e-commerce website using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. The layout was rebuilt with a cleaner visual hierarchy, attractive product sections, responsive components, and a more engaging user experience for browsing beauty products.
data.caseResult: The final website delivers a cleaner and more premium brand appearance, improved responsiveness, better product visibility, and a smoother browsing experience. The project is deployed on Vercel and can be accessed publicly through the live demo.

data.title: Learnova
data.description: Learnova is a modern learning platform built to help students discover courses, watch lessons, track progress, complete quizzes, and purchase premium courses through a smooth online learning experience.
data.caseProblem: Many online learning platforms are either too complex or lack a smooth user experience for students. Students need an easy way to find courses, watch lessons, track progress, and complete learning activities in one place.
data.caseSolution: I built Learnova as a fullstack learning platform with a clean Next.js frontend and a secure Express.js backend. The system includes student and instructor authentication, course management, video lessons, progress tracking, quizzes, payment flow, and an admin dashboard for managing platform data.
data.caseResult: Learnova delivers a complete online learning experience with a modern interface, structured course flow, and scalable backend architecture. This project demonstrates fullstack skills in UI design, API development, authentication, database management, and payment integration.
features: Database management with Prisma and PostgreSQL

data.title: Nexxora
data.description: Nexxora is a modern e-commerce platform built to provide a smooth shopping experience with product browsing, cart management, user authentication, order tracking, and secure payment integration.
data.caseProblem: Many small businesses need an online store that is fast, responsive, easy to manage, and provides a smooth buying experience for customers. Basic catalog websites often lack cart systems, user accounts, payment integration, and order management.
data.caseSolution: built Nexxora as a fullstack e-commerce platform with a Next.js frontend and Express.js backend. The frontend focuses on clean product presentation, responsive layouts, cart interaction, and user-friendly navigation. The backend handles authentication, product data, orders, image uploads, and payment integration using Stripe and Midtrans.
data.caseResult: Nexxora delivers a complete online shopping experience with modern UI, secure user flow, organized backend structure, and scalable database management. This project demonstrates fullstack development skills from interface design to API development and payment processing.
features: Database management with Prisma and PostgreSQL

data.title: Raserva
data.description: Modern restaurant reservation website for Raserva, built with Next.js and TypeScript. Features menu browsing, table booking, food pre-orders, Midtrans deposit payments, and role-based customer and admin dashboards.
data.caseType: Restaurant Reservation App, Booking Platform, Food Ordering System
data.caseProblem: Many restaurants still handle table reservations manually, which can cause booking conflicts, slow confirmation, and poor customer experience.
data.caseSolution: I built Reserva as a web-based restaurant reservation platform where users can browse menus, book tables, choose date and time, order food, and track reservation status. Admins can manage bookings, menu items, and customer orders through a dashboard.
data.caseResult: The project delivered a structured reservation flow, improved booking management, and created a more modern dining experience for customers and restaurant owners.

data.title: Market-Snap
data.description: Market-Snap is a modern grocery web app built with Next.js, designed to help users browse fresh products, search items, manage carts, and place orders easily. It features a clean responsive UI, product categories, smooth navigation, and a user-friendly shopping experience for an online grocery marketplace.
data.caseType: Grocery Web App, E-Commerce Platform, Online Shopping System
data.caseProblem: Many small grocery stores still rely on manual ordering, making it difficult for customers to browse products, manage carts, and place orders quickly online.
data.caseSolution: I built Market-Snap as an online grocery web application where users can explore grocery products, view product details, add items to cart, and place orders through a clean and responsive interface. The backend manages product data, users, orders, and structured API integration.
data.caseResult: The project delivered a practical grocery shopping platform with a smooth user experience, organized product management, and a scalable full-stack structure ready for future payment and admin features.

data.title: Callender Season
data.description: Frontend e-commerce website for Nexxora built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It features a modern responsive UI, product catalog, search, cart, user profile, orders, notifications, authentication pages, smooth animations, and API integration for a complete shopping experience.
